severity_rationale: Cargo releases before the one bundled with Rust 1.66.1 do not verify the SSH host key when fetching a git dependency, so an attacker on the network path can serve modified source that is then built into the project.
remediation: Pin Rust 1.66.1 or later in rust-toolchain.toml. Until then, set net.git-fetch-with-cli = true so the git command line, which verifies host keys, does the fetch.
